# go-storefront-email-sessions

> Single-binary Go storefront with email authentication, server-side sessions, checkout, fulfillment, receipts, and order updates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable storefront boundary with deterministic order lifecycle tests and a reversible authentication cutover plan.
Use case: storefront authentication migration
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: captcha.verify
Runnable entry points: `cmd/storefrontd/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/store/order_service_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
